title: Paginate GET /products with limit and offset
prompt:
Add query-string pagination to GET /products on this sync demo service.

Requirements:
1) handleRequest must remain a synchronous function returning a plain Response { status, body } — never async and never a Promise.
2) GET /products with no query string keeps existing behavior: status 200, body is the full products array (length 3 in the seed).
3) GET /products?limit=N and/or ?offset=M return a paginated slice of products. Parse limit/offset from the path/query portion (e.g. path may be "/products?limit=2&offset=1"). Coerce to non-negative integers; invalid or missing values should fall back sensibly (missing offset → 0; missing limit → remaining items after offset, or full list).
4) Response body for paginated requests should be either:
   - an array of the sliced products, OR
   - an object { items: Product[], total: number } (total = full catalog length).
   Prefer { items, total } when limit or offset is present so callers can page.
5) GET /products/:id and order routes stay unchanged.
6) Add unit tests covering: default list unchanged, limit-only, offset-only, limit+offset, and empty page past the end. Existing product/order tests must stay green.
